name: Unaware Bard
source:
Oh no, you touched a mystical artifact that you really shouldn't have, and now you've shrunk! Fortunately, you are around Kass, the famous Rito bard. 

A kind and gentle soul, if you can get his attention, he might be able to help. Unfortunately, because of your new height, it might be tricky to do so...

[From [url=https://tymberloon.itch.io/unaware-bard]Itch.io[/url]]
